findings.possible_cause: Application startup failure or invalid configuration
findings.recommendation: Inspect container state, previous logs, image and relevant events; fix the underlying cause

evidence: 0/2 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 1 node(s) had untolerated taint
findings.possible_cause: Scheduler reports insufficient GPU capacity on eligible nodes; taints/affinity can also limit eligible nodes
findings.recommendation: Check per-node GPU allocatable/claims, NVIDIA/AMD device plugin, taints, affinity and PVCs

findings.possible_cause: Node health, resource pressure or network configuration
findings.recommendation: Inspect kubelet/node events, node resources and CNI before considering drain/reboot

findings.summary: Service has no ready EndpointSlice backends
findings.possible_cause: Service selector mismatch, failing readiness probes, or no matching ready pods
findings.recommendation: Compare Service selectors with pod labels; inspect pod readiness and EndpointSlices

findings.possible_cause: Container exceeded memory limit or experienced severe memory pressure
findings.recommendation: Compare memory usage, requests/limits and application allocations; do not simply restart

findings.possible_cause: Storage provisioning or volume binding failure
findings.recommendation: Inspect PVC events, StorageClass, CSI controller and available volumes

findings.summary: Deployment has fewer available replicas than desired
findings.possible_cause: Underlying pod failure, scheduling or readiness problem
findings.recommendation: Trace Deployment → ReplicaSet → Pod, then inspect pod findings
